blockingIssues.description: Repeated spring transition literals remain in packages/extension/sidepanel/styles/composer.css (for example lines 882, 1220, 1263, and 1287), so transition consolidation is incomplete within the targeted stylesheet.

Repeated pill/full radius literals and fast transition literals remain in packages/extension/sidepanel/styles/panels.css despite new shared tokens existing, so common-value consolidation is only partial.
packages/extension/sidepanel/panel.ts now assigns window.sidePanelUI only inside __PERF_DEBUG__, which regresses existing E2E and screenshot automation that accesses that handle in normal builds.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a documented verification-only rerun path to refactor-worker so workers know how to handle already-landed commits without forcing staged-diff assumptions.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The refactor-theme-catalog rerun was explicitly verification-only for already-landed commit 7c9cdb9, and its review noted the worker had to deviate from the current skill because no fresh edit/staged diff existed.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Expand refactor-worker guidance for style-only deduplication tasks with quantitative savings targets, including when remaining repeated literals mean the task is still incomplete.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The consolidate-css-patterns review found new shared tokens were introduced, but repeated transition and radius literals remained throughout the targeted CSS surface, so the worker stopped before the contract scope was satisfied.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Warn workers that cleanup/bundle-optimization changes must preserve automation and test hooks even when those hooks look debug-related.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The remove-debug-code review found that hiding window.sidePanelUI behind __PERF_DEBUG__ regressed tests/e2e/run-e2e.ts and scripts/capture-screenshots.ts, which depend on that global in normal builds.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that mission metadata may live in the external orchestrator-provided mission directory rather than only under repo-local .factory/missions paths.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The split-theme-factory-file review observed that workers needed to read mission files from /Users/sero/.factory/missions/... during this mission because the repo-local mission path was absent.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add shared knowledge that window.sidePanelUI is used by automation.
rejectedObservations.reason: recommendation not applied directly because library updates should stay additive and this scrutiny pass found blocking feature regressions rather than stable new knowledge to codify immediately

rejectedObservations.observation: Add a reusable CSS bundle-size measurement procedure to library/services.
rejectedObservations.reason: ambiguous; reviews identified the gap but did not provide a validated measurement workflow suitable for direct documentation in this pass
